Inside the financial double squeeze of AI job loss.

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In today's episode, Vox senior reporter and producer Miles Bryan talks with writer Daniel Kolitz about his piece for The Baffler, "Paid Phones." Kolitz explains what it felt like to be among the first wave of workers displaced by generative AI. The two of them talked about how fintech payday loan apps use hidden fees and subscriptions to profit off of desperate borrowers, and how an online community on Reddit is organizing a quiet resistance against predatory lenders. 

00:00 Intro
04:17 The golden age of SEO ghostwriting 
09:39 The arrival of ChatGPT and job displacement
15:16 Entering the world of “friendly” cash advance apps
24:37 The Reddit ACH revocation community
31:59 The economic outlook of AI job loss
36:24 Climbing out of debt

In the 497th episode of The Ranveer Show, we explore the mysteries of time, consciousness, and spiritual growth with spiritual mentor Bhavesh Yuj. If you’re searching for answers about the nature of time, the journey of the mind, ancient Indian wisdom, and the secrets of true inner growth - this is a conversation you can’t afford to miss.

This episode dives into the difference between Western and Sanatan concepts of time, why childhood feels endless and adulthood fleeting, the root of human suffering, and how to go beyond ego, anxiety, and fear. Bhavesh explains how spiritual practices like yoga, pranayama, and sadhana can transform your reality. We also discuss Patanjali’s wisdom, the power of the three gunas, the role of karma, and how to build a practical spiritual routine in the modern world.

Whether you’re a student, a young professional, or simply on a path of self-discovery, there’s life-changing insight for every listener here.
